title: CUSTOM: Session requests fail during DNS migration
events: Routine msg-cleanup rollout completed; delivery success and queue depth are within normal range.
DNS migration begins for the meta-index service name.
Session request 5xx rate is above its usual baseline.
Chatline 429 responses briefly increased; global request rate remains near quota.
Rolled back dns-migration resolver settings; session request failures are declining.

logs.session-api: WARN meta-index request failed after retry: dial tcp: i/o timeout (resolver cache generation changed)
logs.edge-gw: ERROR session request failed: upstream session-api returned 503

truth: The DNS migration left session-api resolving meta-index to a stale address, causing a fraction of required meta-index calls to fail and session requests to return errors. Rolling back the dns-migration resolver settings restores the correct destination. The notify-relay deployment and brief Chatline 429 alert are unrelated.
